steps.name: publish
argv:
# EVERY FILE IS NAMED IN FULL, not matched by a glob -- the b14 lane's scar:
# a glob that misses publishes nothing while returning a code that reads
# like a fetch failure, and box_enqueue.output_path_problems refuses a spec
# whose declared artifacts are never named by any step, which a wildcard
# defeats. Missing ONE file is a FAIL of the job.
import hashlib, os, shutil
from_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b04-mac-plate-0819-out"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b04-mac-plate-0819"
NAMES = [
    "04-the-footnote-mac-plate-r1s1.png",
    "04-the-footnote-mac-plate-r1s1.yaml",
]
WANT_PNG = "5dd35da532612e5d85c15ef3353068bf1e44675f8ddfc73c316ac2f654d4e350"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
lines = []
for name in NAMES:
    src = os.path.join(from_dir, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        raise SystemExit("!! missing staged file: " + src)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, name)
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + name)
    print(h, name, flush=True)
got = [l.split("  ")[0] for l in lines if l.endswith(".png")][0]
if got != WANT_PNG:
    raise SystemExit("!! PNG SHA MISMATCH AFTER COPY\n   want %s\n   have %s"
                     % (WANT_PNG, got))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b04-mac-plate-0819.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(NAMES), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
